# Vendored frontend assets

These files are stored locally so the prototype does not depend on a public CDN
at runtime:

- `bootstrap/bootstrap.min.css`: Bootstrap 5.3.8, MIT License,
  <https://getbootstrap.com/>
- `htmx/htmx.min.js`: HTMX 2.0.10, 0BSD License,
  <https://htmx.org/>

Versions are deliberate. Review upstream release notes and rerun page tests
before replacing either file.
